t: This is the Don Lockwood statue in Leicester Square, part of the Scenes in the Square trail. It depicts the character played by Gene Kelly, the American dancer, actor, singer, director and choreographer. Kelly was known for his energetic, athletic style, and wanted to create what he called dance for the common man. With Stanley Donen, he co-directed some of the best-regarded musical films of the 1940s and 1950s.
